correctness.rationale: Every total dominating set of a crown needs at least two vertices from each shore, while every 2+2 shore selection works, proving gamma_t=4. Order six leaves Dominator at most three moves in either starting convention. For n>=4, four within-shore pairs yield a pairing certificate and hence a four-move win in both games; the general gamma_t lower bound makes it sharp. Any four-pair certificate must have every transversal 2+2, which rules out cross-pairs and forces exactly two pairs per shore. The counting formula follows from the 3 perfect matchings on each chosen four-set. The embedded checker independently verifies bounded cases.
